name: Beam extraction, transport and installation (husky2)

formation.note: base planar pose [x, y, yaw] in the payload planar frame: at the rack, in line while carrying, and in front of the supports (in their frame). On the route every base has its own poses (route.bases).

base_paths.note: pose paths [x, y, yaw] of the base origins: a turn on the spot about the turning point of the skid model, a straight leg with a curve into the lane along the rack, and the straight run into the station; each from rest to rest. The heading is that of a base that turns about its turning point. rho: length a turn counts for, per radian

gates.note: closed from the moment the cart leaves its start position until it has left the aisle

steering.note: the origin of every base keeps the planar offset formation.carry[:2] from the payload; the base turns about the point of its centre line that the skid model gives for its wheel loads (turning_point_ahead_m), and its heading follows from that

load_sharing.note: weighted minimum-norm distribution; the internal wrench is defined relative to it

bounds.note: declared admissible bounds checked by the audit; clearance excludes the supports the payload rests on. Grasp force: the 100 N range of the UR10e wrist sensor less the weight of the clamp it also carries (11.8 N), rounded down; grasp moment: its 10 N m range. Traction: resultant ground force of the wheels of a base over its friction capacity (the wheels of a skid-steered base slide whenever it turns).

declared: Task data designed by tools/build_mission.py from the physical records and the listed choices.

choices.turn_search: scan of the corner on a 0.15 m grid at every heading (mission.route.bottleneck_turn)
